title: Replace the entire Vercel AI SDK stack with @earendil-works/pi-ai, pi-schema, pi-telemetry, and pi-mcp
summary: Remove ai@7, all six @ai-sdk/* packages, @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider, and ollama-ai-provider-v2 across the monorepo, rebasing @umwelten/core, @umwelten/evaluation, @umwelten/supplier, and @umwelten/protocols onto @earendil-works/pi-* 1.6.0.
resolution: Pi provides maintained multi-provider streaming, local llama.cpp/vLLM dialect controls, eval-free JSON Schema validation, telemetry, and Streamable HTTP MCP without bespoke AI SDK glue.

comments.body: Swap out custom runtime code, get rid of everything related to the Vercel SDK, and build evaluations and session tooling on top of Pi and Pi Durable.
Audited all 11 workspace packages and replaced Vercel AI SDK runners, tool definitions, and MCP client transports with @earendil-works/pi-ai, pi-schema, pi-telemetry, and pi-mcp 1.6.0.

title: Keep Pi Durable Habitat orchestration generic across Storage and ExecutionEnv rather than coupling to Cloudflare Workers
summary: Model DurableHabitat and HabitatHost over @earendil-works/pi-durable's host-agnostic Storage (defaulting to Node SQLite per Habitat) and optional ExecutionEnv (local, pi-env SSH, Gondolin, or Sprites) with zero Cloudflare Worker assumptions.
resolution: A generic Harness runs identically on laptops, single-process Node hosts multiplexing dozens of Habitats, containers, or Postgres without edge-isolate restrictions.

comments.body: Initially framed the Habitat brain around Cloudflare Durable Objects based on earendil-works/pi-durable-cloudflare.
Why are you talking about Cloudflare Workers? We should be generic about it.
Reframed DurableHabitat and HabitatHost strictly around generic pi-durable Storage, ExecutionEnv, and @leocavalcante/pi-a2a on standard Node.

title: Call pi-ai models.stream() directly instead of streamSimple() so benchmarks never receive a default maxTokens clamp
summary: Invoke models.stream() in BaseModelRunner and omit maxTokens unless Stimulus.maxTokens is explicitly set on the task.
resolution: pi-ai's streamSimple() calls buildBaseOptions(), which always injects clampMaxTokensToContext() and would violate Umwelten's uncapped benchmark invariant.

comments.body: Verified in @earendil-works/pi-ai/src/api/simple-options.ts that streamSimple() always populates maxTokens, whereas raw models.stream() leaves OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible, and Google requests uncapped when maxTokens is undefined.

title: Project Pi JSONL trees and Pi Durable SQLite stores into Umwelten Explorations and package Umwelten tools as @umwelten/pi
summary: Add PiDurableSessionAdapter alongside PiSessionAdapter so cross-tool session search, Explorations, and Reflections work uniformly over Pi CLI and Pi Durable stores, and expose Mycel, session search, and knowledge promotion as an installable @umwelten/pi package.
resolution: Lets Pi Durable own live transactional transcripts and forks while Umwelten focuses on cross-session sensemaking, reflection, and evaluation.

comments.body: All the session management stuff can be done in Pi Durable, and refactor reusable Umwelten capabilities into Pi extensions.

title: Enforce Owned vs. Mounted repository write guards via ToolTask hooks and preserve ui:// EmbeddedResources across MCP and A2A
summary: Enforce Owned read/write and Mounted read-only paths in a pi-durable ToolTask beforeTool hook over standard CodingTools, serve A2A 1.0 via @leocavalcante/pi-a2a/durable, and preserve ui:// EmbeddedResources in RemoteMcpClient.
resolution: Replaces custom file tool wrappers and FileTaskStore while keeping MCP-UI widgets intact for web rooms and UI-capable MCP hosts.

comments.body: Clarify MCP UI resource handling and check existing Pi A2A extensions.

title: Preserve Mycel's zero-core boundary, micro-dollar metering, and outbound Supplier dial-in protocol
summary: Keep @umwelten/mycel independent of @umwelten/core, meter traffic in integer micro-dollars at the Exchange boundary, filter Offers strictly on Guarantees and Capabilities before price ranking, and connect GPU Suppliers via outbound WebSockets.
resolution: Prevents dependency cycles and Postgres dependencies on GPU hosts while guaranteeing policy compliance and accurate billing on interrupted streams.

comments.body: Keep Mycel and Supplier intact and connect to Mycel over its OpenAI-compatible HTTP wire.

title: Archive the legacy VitePress docs to docs-archive/ and adopt session-spec-verify for active specifications
summary: Move the existing VitePress documentation and historical ADRs to docs-archive/, vendor session-spec-verify skills into .agents/skills/, and maintain modular conceptual spec packs, protected standards, decisions.jsonl, and verification runs under docs/.
resolution: Replaces drifted prose docs with cold-rebuild-complete, machine-validated specifications while deferring website redesign.

comments.body: Use https://github.com/The-Focus-AI/session-spec-verify to clean up the specifications, and archive the existing docs and we can rethink the website later.

title: Eliminate core/providers, custom Umwelten Pi provider shims, legacy AI SDK shims, schema/memory/rate-limit modules, subprocess runners, and custom MCP client
summary: Delete 93 legacy files (~15,000 LoC) across core, protocols, habitat, and pi — removing the entire packages/core/src/providers/ directory, packages/core/src/{schema,memory,rate-limit}/, smart_runner.ts, step-assembler.ts, usage-extractor.ts, stimulus/{creative,analysis,coding}, unused audio/image/pdf tools, custom @umwelten/pi provider registration, habitat subprocess pi-runner/claude-sdk-runner/gaia-server, and the custom JSON-RPC MCP client — running directly on @earendil-works/pi-ai builtinModels() + models.json and @earendil-works/pi-mcp.
resolution: Removes every parallel Umwelten provider/schema/MCP/subprocess layer so Pi's native builtinModels() + ~/.pi/agent/models.json + pi-mcp + pi-durable own runtime plumbing while Umwelten focuses strictly on evaluations, session sensemaking, DurableHabitats, and Mycel.

comments.body: Do we need to have all these providers? Why do we need the Umwelten Pi provider at all? Let's clean up everything.

Deleted packages/core/src/providers/, schema/, memory/, rate-limit/, smart_runner, dead stimulus prompts/tools, custom @umwelten/pi provider, legacy pi-runner/claude-sdk-runner/gaia-server, and custom JSON-RPC MCP client, routing directly through Pi builtinModels() + models.json and @earendil-works/pi-mcp.

anchor: packages/pi/src/models.ts, packages/sessions/, packages/evaluation/, packages/habitat/, examples/, README.md
title: Eliminate packages/core, packages/ui, cognition/Stimulus/Interaction, legacy Docker Habitat, redundant unit tests, and pre-Pi examples
summary: Remove packages/core, packages/ui, legacy Habitat/Gaia/ChannelBridge/FileTaskStore (~56k LoC), ~190 obsolete unit test files, and 27 pre-Pi example directories, keeping only @umwelten/{pi,sessions,evaluation,habitat,protocols,mycel,substrate,supplier,cli,umwelten}, typechecked Pi-native examples, and rewritten docs/specs.
resolution: Focuses Umwelten strictly on what is not built into Pi — multi-model evaluations/Elo/Jev, cross-harness session Explorations and promotion, DurableHabitats on pi-durable + A2A 1.0, OAuth 2.1 mcp-serve, and the Mycel Token Exchange — cutting workspace size by ~78% and test runtime from 103s to 22s.

comments.body: Can we get rid of unnecessary tests and focus on having stuff inside of the verification process? Do we even need the concepts of cognition and other top-level things if we have it inside of Pi? Rethink the documentation and make sure all examples are removed or ported over so we focus on things not built into Pi and show how to use the extensions we're building.

Deleted packages/core and packages/ui completely, collapsed EvalSuite and Supplier probing directly onto @umwelten/pi's runPiTurn over @earendil-works/pi-ai, made @umwelten/sessions standalone, trimmed Habitat strictly to DurableHabitat + HabitatHost + planProvision, ported/replaced all examples under examples/tsconfig.json, and rewrote root/spec docs.

title: Replace Docker-out-of-Docker Gaia orchestrator with single-container pi-durable GaiaHost
summary: Eliminate /var/run/docker.sock mounts, child Habitat containers, Dockerfile.twitter-habitat, Dockerfile.coding-agent, and preview-router, running Gaia as a single-process Node 24 pi-durable GaiaHost multiplexing SQLite DurableHabitats with dual jwt+bearer auth and rollback-protected redeploy.sh.
resolution: Multiplexing SQLite DurableHabitats in one process removes host Docker daemon privilege exposure and multi-image deploy complexity while preserving Caddy TLS ingress, comma-separated GAIA_API_KEY auth, per-speaker GAIA_JWKS_URL JWT isolation, and declarative /api/habitats persistence.

comments.body: Implemented GaiaHost in @umwelten/habitat with persistent habitats-registry.json, dual jwt+bearer auth, root gaia A2A 1.0 orchestrator tools, subdomain + path routing, single-image Dockerfile, rollback-protected deploy/gaia/redeploy.sh, and gaia-ci Docker smoke tests.
